newsitem.title: EGYPT: Top U.S. military official in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Top U.S. military official in Egypt.

text.p: Chairman of the U.S. Joint Chiefs of Staff Army General John Shalikashvili arrived in Cairo on Saturday for talks with Egyptian military counterparts, airport officials said.

Egyptian officials said Shalikashvili, who flew in from Washington, will meet Egypt's Chief of Staff Magdi Hetata and that he may also hold talks with Defence Minister Mohamed Hussein Tantawi and Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak.
Shalikashvili, who will return to Washington on January 10, is also due to visit Saudi Arabia and Israel.
